claims.quote: "The rope took Garr with a single, terrible explanation; he swung once on the beam and then was still."
"She pressed the willow-pin to his lips and kissed it, and then, without a word, she looped the rope over her own head."

"When the crowd had been pushed back Marta stooped and found the little willow-pin where it had fallen and folded it into her palm as if it were something that might still be kept from being broken. She pressed it to her breast, a gesture that was not comfort but accusation."

"Marta folded her hands over the pin and whispered to herself the line she had already spoken in a corridor and could not take back. 'I kept their hour like a prayer; they have asked me to unmake that prayer.'"
"Rowan stood with his head lowered. Later he would say what he had said here in smaller voice: that he had answered an order; that the weight would remain."
"Lord Harrow's face did not fall into triumph; it was the flat, exhausted line of a man who had paid a bill he thought would settle favor and found only more accounts."
